name: NEMA 17 stepper motor (frame envelope)
summary: NEMA 17 mounting-frame envelope: 42.3 mm square body, 31 mm square bolt pattern of M3 holes, 22 mm pilot boss 2 mm proud, 5 mm shaft 24 mm long, plus the lead exit. Origin on the mount face, on the shaft axis; the body hangs into -Z.
preview: NEMA 17 frame envelope, 42.3 mm square, 31 mm bolt pattern, 5 mm shaft, stack 20-60 mm (default 39)

body_length.doc: stack length behind the mount face, mm

component.frame: mount face on the shaft axis; body into -Z, pilot boss and shaft into +Z
simplifications: frame envelope only: no laminations, windings, end bells or fasteners
mounting holes are blind envelopes, not threads
no corner radii on the stack, and no flat on the shaft
the lead exit is a plain cylindrical stub; it is modelled because a four-hole square pattern is four-fold symmetric and it is the only feature that can name one hole
